gen-fs-kalam-gf-orbit: Close handwritten bundles are the first trait of Kalam, inviting and cozy across the heading line. Orbit keeps a sans column moving, each character floating apart.
gen-fs-kalam-satoshi: Inviting handwritten bundles lead in Kalam, cozy and close. Satoshi then holds a stretch of plain sans, a soaring x-height and strokes cut from one gauge.
gen-fs-karma-gf-lexend-peta: Unshaded curves and wide-mouthed c shapes in Lexend Peta feel approachable, with a big x-height and tight ascenders. Karma sits above while that sans-serif holds a column.
gen-fs-karma-gf-lexend-zetta: A gap you can see through in each s marks Karma, comfortable serif with middling weight. Lexend Zetta holds a stretch of plain sans in cut-ribbon strokes, widely tracked.
gen-fs-karma-gf-montserrat-alternates: Karma shows a slight pressure shadow like worn charcoal, with a gap in each s. And Montserrat Alternates holds a stretch of sans-serif, round rims matching stems as lowercase crowds the caps.
gen-fs-kola-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads stretched-out and bookish, counters breathing, no thick-thin shifts. Kola stays a bold, distinctive display above, while the serif likes a slightly smaller size.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-fanwood-text: Large-eyed lowercase and gentle swelling on curves give Fanwood Text a literary, bookish read. Fanwood Text holds a column as a text serif, while New Title locks chain-like display letters above.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-nastaliq-urdu: New Title locks chain-like letters with high lowercase against the capitals, bold and modern. Noto Nastaliq Urdu likes a slightly smaller size, mild stress in o and e, tight rhythm.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-serif-lao: New Title plants high lowercase locked like a fine chain, bold and modern against the caps. Noto Serif Lao prefers a smaller size, a bookish serif with gentle weight shifts.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-noto-serif-malayalam: Big counters in every small letter give Noto Serif Malayalam a bookish, refined read. Noto Serif Malayalam holds a column, bowls thinning gracefully, while New Title stays chain-locked above.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-alegreya: Tightly knit rows of text give Oswald its confident, strong display punch. And Alegreya holds a column with a soft cadence of fuller stems and slimmer links.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-besley: Oswald knits confident, strong rows of display text into a tight strip. Besley likes a slightly smaller size, a dignified serif whose c stays far from closing.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-maitree: Confident tightly knit rows make Oswald feel strong, a display strip with little air between letters. Oswald wants a few large words; Maitree stays the serif below.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Packed rows of display text mark Oswald at once. Sawarabi Mincho holds a classic serif column, while Oswald belongs in a short shout of large letters.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sedan-sc: Strong is the first hit of Oswald, packed into tight rows. Sedan SC holds a classic serif column with mild thicks, while Oswald stays large and brief.
